feats/energy-admixture-871.name: Energy Admixture
feats/energy-admixture-871.effectSummary: Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire matching an energy type you selected with Energy Substitution. You can add an equal amount of that energy damage to any spell with an energy descriptor; the original and added energy damage are rolled separately and each observes the base spell's damage cap independently. Opposed energy types can be combined. The spell gains both energy descriptors and uses a slot four levels higher than normal.

You may use Energy Admixture on a spell already altered by Energy Substitution, and you may admix the same energy type a spell already uses, effectively doubling its normal damage dice.

feats/heretic-of-the-faith-1379.effectSummary: You may grossly violate your deity's code of conduct without losing spells or class abilities, but still must obey your class alignment restriction. feats/holy-potency-1400.effectSummary: Grants two tactical maneuvers based on whether you channel positive or negative energy. Conduit of Life—after attempting to turn undead, on the next round a cure or other positive-energy attack against undead gains damage equal to half the turning-check result and save DC + your Charisma bonus; if its attack roll is a natural 20 and the target fails its save, it deals double damage. Negative: Conduit of Death—after rebuking undead, on the next round an inflict or other negative-energy attack against a living creature gains damage equal to half the turning-check result, save DC + Charisma bonus, and +1 to the attack's critical threat range. Touch of Death—after casting an inflict spell, a melee hit against a living creature on the next round deals extra damage equal to twice that spell's level.
